title: Advanced passive voice
grammar: Passive with modals, It is said that, He is believed to

phases.name: Presentation
phases.content: In this unit you will learn advanced passive structures used in formal and journalistic English.

phases.name: Discovery
phases.content: Read these sentences. The report must be submitted by Friday. It is said that he is very rich. He is believed to be abroad. Notice the impersonal passive with it is said / believed.

phases.name: Guided practice
phases.prompt: The meeting ___ postponed until next week.
phases.explanation: Present perfect passive: has/have been + past participle.

phases.name: Free practice
phases.prompt: Rewrite 3 news headlines using the impersonal passive.

phases.name: Mini-test
phases.prompt: It ___ that the company will close next month.
phases.explanation: Impersonal passive: It is said that ...
